settings.heading: Settings

howToPlay.heading: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Merge coins in order to get the GG.
howToPlay.controlsBody: Tap or click to drop a coin. Move it before dropping to choose where it lands.
howToPlay.chain: Copper -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold -> Ruby -> Amethyst -> Platinum -> Emerald -> Queen -> Sapphire -> Diamond -> GG.
howToPlay.specialRule: Bring 3 GG coins into contact with each other and they explode: earning an extra points bonus and freeing up space in the jar to keep playing.

dialog.errorOutro: Please refresh the page and try again later.

landscape.message: Please rotate your device to portrait mode to play the game.

meta.title: Coin Kingdom
meta.description: A puzzle game where you merge coins to reach the Supernova.
